geometry_definition: 24 unsegmented RF rods; two separate internal DC endcap disks; grounded cylindrical shield and outer end plates
model: static Laplace conductor basis solutions; not yet particle integration

incomplete_mesh_attempts.reason: FEM assembly/solve did not complete within the available run window; stopped before a field checkpoint was written

DC_endcap_screen.basis: both DC disk endcaps at +1 V; all 24 RF rods, shield and outer end plates at 0 V
DC_endcap_screen.axial_field_derivative_method: Savitzky-Golay cubic derivative on the FEM axial potential; 21 samples (1 mm window)

limitations: P1 tetra FEM; sharp conductor edges are not surface-field converged
ideal end-disk supports/wiring and dielectric feedthroughs are omitted
field solution only; no trajectories or RF breakdown qualification in this run
